scientific_integrity: Finite calculation reproduced by standalone exact source code; two complete simplex enumerations and two mod-two boundary algorithms with an elementary-collapse intermediate agree. No independent external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact reduced simplicial homology only with F2 coefficients for the four (28,12,6,4) strongly regular graphs. No integral homology, torsion, homotopy-wedge description or other parameter family is claimed; unindexed bibliographic equivalence remains possible.
title: Neighborhood homology distinguishes all four strongly regular \((28,12,6,4)\) graphs
